    val evaluator = context.evaluator

    if (returnName != null && isRelevantClass(returnName)) return true

    // Receiver type for instance methods

    if (receiverName != null && isRelevantClass(receiverName)) return true

    // Resolved method's containing class
    val resolved = node.resolve() as? PsiMethod
    val containingClass = resolved?.containingClass?.qualifiedName
    if (containingClass != null && isRelevantClass(containingClass)) return true

    return false
}

        "clearCredentialState",

        "clearCredentialStateCredentialAsync"
